zones.handle_reference: ChII:handle represents consultant,home or current abode when away;directly underneath denotes present/immediate circumstances.
zones.convention: bottom_circle/bottom_centre are named subregions of source bottom,retaining FigureVIII circle/centre labels. No numeric boundaries,absolute dates or priority over under-handle present/immediate qualification.
zones.timing: Qualitative source associations only;independent under-handle/depth qualifiers coexist without precedence. No calendar date,deadline or numeric confidence.

saucer_documentary.note: Centre consultant;surrounding circle home/near events;more distant circle later;outer rim remote future. Not executable cup zones and not interchangeable.

conditions.evaluation: Each case records intrinsic/effective status and individual conditions. Known negative is not applicable;missing facts insufficient;competing declarations retained without repair. No text-based inference.
conditions.adjacency: Provided neighbor list is complete;omission unknown. One-sided positive links suffice unless contradicted by another complete list. No geometric distance inferred.
conditions.dots: Source surrounding-dots predicate requires declared surrounding arrangement plus an associated observation. Plain adjacency alone is insufficient.
conditions.multiplicity: User declares source single/several quantifier. No numeric threshold or silent observation aggregation. Lone-cross contradiction is reported.
conditions.identity: Postal square/oblong mark distinct from alphabetic initial;Organ distinct from Barrel Organ;coal scoop not Coal Scuttle. Uncertain/alternative identities block definitive cases.

manual_schema.mark: One Latin initial,blank or null;other glyphs may remain raw observations. No name identification.
manual_schema.ordering: Input order retained;IDs unique;adjacency references existing different observations.
manual_schema.raw: Unicode,whitespace,omissions,nulls and user associations preserved verbatim;all personal context optional.

accounts: Organ/acorn on lower circle:delayed hope/ultimate success account

documentary_example.scope: Explicitly requested original-source comparison only,not a generic organ/acorn grammar or an automatically recognised cup.
documentary_example.requirements: Source caption positions and explicit organ/acorn adjacency/lower-circle declarations;musician-specific account requires declared musician. Coal-scoop account needs observed beetle. Tea-cosy example and marital dictionary cases remain separate.
